title: Ciphersuites, including a post-quantum hybrid, which lands on the OpenMLS fork
description:
Mark, 2026-11-22, hard blocker and a genuine unknown.

Haven advertises mls_ciphersuites [1] only, confirmed from its live
directory this session. By 2028 a hybrid ML-KEM suite is plausibly
mandatory.

The point Mark makes: this is an OpenMLS question, not a mimid one. It
lands on the fork, so the beads that matter are mimid-m12g (upstream the
remaining fork commits, retire superseded ones) and mimid-1wgh.4.69
(rebase mimid-0.9.1 onto upstream main). A fork carrying unmerged
patches is a bad place to be standing when a new ciphersuite has to be
adopted on someone else's schedule.

Unknown, and recorded as unknown: whether OpenMLS will have a hybrid
suite by then, whether it will be the one a regulator names, and whether
mimid's fork will have been retired by then. Nothing to implement yet;
the actionable part is keeping the fork debt down so that adopting a
suite is a dependency bump rather than a port.
